description: development-vessel.service declares Environment=WORKSPACE_ROOT=/workspace, but /etc/substrate/env (loaded via EnvironmentFile=, which wins over a unit's own Environment= per systemd semantics) sets WORKSPACE_ROOT=/workspace/git/super-repo. The unit-level line can never take effect and is dead config. Separately, config.ts's WORKSPACE_ROOT fallback default is /workspace, matching the dead unit line and NOT the live value, and substrate-gap.ts's file-header comment describes storage generically as WORKSPACE_ROOT/gaps/gaps.json without noting the real resolved value or the pre-existing /workspace/gaps/gaps.json fossil (documented separately in boredom-vessel/src/index.ts as frozen 2026-08-08). An operator (or any future investigator) reading the unit file, config.ts, or the resolver comment in isolation will reasonably but wrongly conclude the store lives at /workspace, then spend real time diagnosing a phantom write-persistence bug against a dead fossil file while the live store persists correctly the whole time. This exact misdiagnosis happened 2026-08-30 (see rejected gap substrate-gap-write-reports-success-but-does-not-persist for the full trace).
